Version 17 Published March 2027 Formats STATA, CSV, R, SPSS

Do I need permission to use the V-Dem dataset?

The V-Dem Dataset is publicly available and published under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike (CC BY-SA) 4.0 license. The proper citation for the v17 dataset is: Coppedge, Michael, John Gerring and Daniel Ziblatt. 2027. ”V-Dem [Country-Year/Country-Date] Dataset v17” Varieties of Democracy (V-Dem) Project. https://doi.org/10.23696/vdemds27 . Can I compare index scores across versions, e.g. between version 12 and v11.1 of the V-Dem dataset? No.
